title: chamfer
body:
## chamfer

Bevels selected edges of an existing solid with one equal distance on both adjoining faces (native Part::Chamfer) and produces a solid. Edge selection works exactly as for fillet: one-based indices of the base solid or a geometric selector with an exact expected count. Choose it for lead-in bevels and broken edges where a flat face is wanted instead of a round.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The default edges [1] is just the first edge of the base topology; choose edges deliberately.
- Oversized or intersecting chamfers fail native checks; planning only checks that indices exist.
- Covered by an analytic-volume acceptance fixture (all twelve edges of a block); not exhaustively qualified.

Native binding: `Part::Chamfer`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `distance` | Chamfer setback in millimetres, applied equally on both faces adjoining every selected edge, so a chamfer between perpendicular faces is a 45° bevel. Too large a distance for the adjoining faces makes FreeCAD fail the chamfer. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `1` |
| `edges` | Which edges of the base solid to bevel: either a list of one-based edge indices or a geometric selector with an exact expected count. The selection always refers to the base input's edges, not to the chamfer result; Schemaxis resolves it, assigns the indices to the native feature and rechecks them after reopening. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1000,"uniqueItems":true},{"type":"object","properties":{"where":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"curve":{"type":"enum","values":["line","circle"]},"parallelTo":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-1000000.0,"maximum":1000000.0},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3},"onPlane":{"type":"object","properties":{"axis":{"type":"enum","values":["x","y","z"],"required":true},"coordinate":{"type":"number","required":true}}},"length":{"type":"object","properties":{"minimum":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"required":true},"maximum":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"required":true}}}}},"expect":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":1000,"required":true},"tolerance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-09,"maximum":0.01,"default":1e-06},"angularTolerance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-09,"maximum":0.01,"default":1e-06}}}]}` | `[1]` |
